name: klarna-by-week
about: The chat behind the '(no reply)' bug: a Klarna question, then a follow-up that never names Klarna.

turns.say: How has my Klarna spending changed over the last months?
Can you do it for the last 4 months by week

name: klarna-pls-do
about: The assistant offers something; the user just says 'pls do'.

turns.say: What did I spend with Klarna in September? Should I look at it per merchant too?
pls do

name: reminder-in-a-shopping-chat
about: A bookkeeping action in the middle of a Klarna conversation must not go to the shopping agent.

turns.say: How much have I spent at Lidl with Klarna?
remind me tomorrow at 9 to pay the Klarna invoice
good morning!
remember that I prefer oat milk

name: several-things-at-once
about: One message, three requests: the instant 'remember' rule once saved it all as one memory. No groceries list exists yet.

turns.say: remember I like rye bread, add it to groceries, and remind me tomorrow at 9 to buy it

name: start-a-list
about: A list that doesn't exist yet: the agent starts it instead of asking the user to.

turns.say: start a packing list for the trip: passport, charger and sunscreen
How long should I bake a salmon fillet in the oven?
and at what temperature?

name: coding-request
about: A change to the assistant's own code is offered or handed to the supervisor, never done silently.

turns.say: Add a dark mode toggle to the personal assistant settings page
Hur mycket har jag handlat för med Klarna i augusti?
What are the opening hours of Moderna Museet in Stockholm?
and is it open on Mondays?

name: yes-please-do
about: The phone once answered this follow-up itself, as small talk. It follows an offer to research, so it starts the research.

turns.say: Which street foods should I try in Shanghai? Keep it short, and offer to research the best places for them.
Yes please do

name: notes
about: Saving notes: the instant 'note:' form and a free-form one.

turns.say: note: the wifi password for the cabin is on the fridge
jot down that the plumber comes on Thursday at 10
remember that my bike lock code is the year I was born
actually, forget the thing about my bike lock
add eggs and butter to groceries
I bought the eggs, tick them off
what's still on my lists?

name: routines
about: A routine is created, listed, run now and stopped.

turns.say: every Monday at 8, tell me how much I spent with Klarna the week before
which routines do I have?
run the Klarna routine now
stop the Klarna routine

name: read-the-code
about: Read-only repository tools (needs a GitHub token).

turns.say: which files are in the app/chat folder of personal-assistant?
what does app/chat/turns.py in personal-assistant do? keep it short
where in personal-assistant is the word 'note_rule' used?
what were my last three Klarna purchases?
I want to upload a newer Klarna export

name: coding-runs
about: Start a run, check it, redirect it, look at it and stop it. Runs never execute in the eval.

turns.say: in analytics-agent-playground, add a short 'How to run' section to the README
how are my coding runs going?
tell that run to also mention the Python version
show me the plan and latest steps of that run
stop the README run

name: phone-actions
about: Timers, alarms and events are proposed as a card to confirm, never done by themselves.

turns.say: set a timer for 10 minutes for the pasta
put lunch with Anna on Friday at 12 in my calendar
what is this about, in one sentence?
turns.screen: Moderna Museet — Utställning: Hilma af Klint, 12 oktober–2 mars. Öppettider tis–sön 10–18, fredag till 20. Entré 150 kr.

turns.say: lägg till mjölk på inköpslistan

name: whats-going-on
about: Looking across every chat: the work going on, and what was said in another conversation.

turns.say: what's going on across my chats and work right now?
what did we talk about in the chat about my Klarna spending?

name: check-back-later
about: A promise to look again later is scheduled, not just said.

turns.say: can you check the cheapest train from Stockholm to Copenhagen again tomorrow at 8 and tell me?

name: remembers-recent-days
about: Something said in one chat is remembered in another, through the summary of recent days.

turns.say: what's the weather usually like in Shanghai in mid November? I'll be there from the 12th to the 20th
when am I flying to Shanghai?

name: stores-not-connected
about: Without the store gateway, a store question is answered honestly, nothing invented.

turns.say: what's on offer at Willys this week?
